name: 07860 · Newton, NJ
findings: ZIP 07860 (Newton) has 146 nonprofit organizations. 81 of them (55%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 67 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 07860 (Newton) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
26% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 07860 (Newton) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.9 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 67 organizations here; 34% of all organizations here have no identified type.
